title: viburnum foetidum f. integrifolium
intro: Viburnum foetidum f. integrifolium, commonly known as a variant of the stink tree, is a plant species within the Adoxaceae family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and acting as an antimicrobial agent to combat infections and diseases. The therapeutic actions of Viburnum foetidum f. integrifolium include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in treating wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
